# Refined Spec: Apparently — Beta Live-User Token Signup & Billing

**Status:** READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION  
**Project:** /Users/kpasch/Documents/apparently  
**Submitted by:** kale@smrter.us (operator/counsel), 2026-07-28  
**Strategy:** PORTFOLIO_STRATEGY_V2 Part 12.7  
**Legal gate:** Owner-only review of material deviations (licensing, data custody, user rights)  
**Workflow:** parallel_fleet  

---

## Objective
Real users can sign up and start burning tokens in production NOW. All features not production-ready are explicitly labeled beta via `<BetaBanner>` component; nothing is hidden.

---

## 1. Token Signup + Self-Serve Billing (Core)

### 1.1 Self-Service Signup Flow
- **Path:** `/auth/signup` → email → password → Stripe test mode → confirm email → `app/dashboard`
- **Auto-create organization:** One org per user at signup (named `${email}-org`), stored in `public.organizations` table
- **Test fixture:** Staging environment account `test-user@apparently.local` pre-created for manual QA
- **Files:**
  - `app/auth/signup.tsx` — form component (email, password, terms acceptance)
  - `lib/auth/signup.ts` — service (validate email, hash password, create user + org)
  - `supabase/migrations/` — add `auth.users.created_at`, ensure `public.organizations.user_id` FK

### 1.2 Stripe Integration (Test-to-Live Flip)
- **Config key:** `ORCH_STRIPE_MODE` (values: `test`, `live`), stored in `fleet_config` table
- **Permission model:** Owner-only to flip; read-only to other operators
- **Implementation:**
  - Environment: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` (injected at build/deploy; use test key in dev, live key in prod)
  - Feature flag: `STRIPE_LIVE_MODE` in `public.features` table (default: false)
  - Files:
    - `lib/billing/stripe.ts` — singleton `getStripeClient()` that reads `ORCH_STRIPE_MODE` from fleet config
    - `lib/billing/checkout.ts` — `createCheckoutSession()` (respects mode flag)
    - `supabase/functions/stripe_webhook/` — webhook handler for `customer.subscription.updated`, `invoice.payment_succeeded`

### 1.3 Pricing Tiers (Concrete)
| Tier | Name | Cost | Token Allowance | Billing | Target |
|------|------|------|-----------------|---------|--------|
| Free | Free | $0 | 10K tokens/month | Monthly reset | Testers |
| Starter | Starter | $9/month | 100K tokens/month | Monthly auto-renew | Individuals |
| Pro | Professional | $49/month | 1M tokens/month | Monthly auto-renew | Teams |
| Enterprise | Custom | TBD | Custom | Annual/custom | Orgs |

**Base rate:** $0.01 per 1,000 tokens (overages billed monthly)  
**Premium tier launch:** When firm launches (Q3 2026, contingent on legal review clearance)  
**Files:**
- `lib/billing/pricing.ts` — export `PRICING_TIERS`, `getTierByCode(code)`, `calculateTokenAllowance(tier, daysHeld)`, `costPerToken()`
- `config/pricing.json` — tier definitions, per-surface rate overrides (optional for API/dashboard variants)

### 1.4 Token Consumption Metering
- **Tracking:** In-process event buffer (fail-soft, never wedge caller)
  - Fires on every API call: `recordTokenBurn(userId, tokensUsed, modelUsed, endpoint)`
  - Buffer flushes to `public.token_events` table every 30s or on 1K events (whichever first)
  - Retention: 90 days in DB, archive to cold storage after
- **Overflow handling:** If flush fails, log and drop (never block); operator alerts on flush error rate >0.1%
- **Files:**
  - `lib/metering/token_burn.ts` — `recordTokenBurn()`, `flushBuffer()`, `getCurrentMonthUsage(userId)`
  - `supabase/migrations/` — add `public.token_events` (user_id, tokens, model, endpoint, timestamp)

---

## 2. Legal Docs & Compliance (Pre-Implementation Gate)

### 2.1 Legal Review Timing
- **When:** BEFORE implementation starts (not after)
- **Gated by:** Owner-only sign-off required
- **Material deviation:** Any change to liability, data custody, user rights, or token usage restrictions
- **Outcome:** Legal approval email → stored in `docs/legal-sign-offs/`

### 2.2 Required Documents
- **Terms of Service:** `docs/terms.md` (cover token usage, overage billing, free-tier limits)
- **Privacy Policy:** `docs/privacy.md` (cover token event logging, retention, user deletion)
- **Billing Addendum:** `docs/billing-terms.md` (Stripe integration, payment failure, dispute handling)
- **Beta Label:** Explicit notice in footer + signup page: "⚠️ Beta — features may change; data may be deleted."
- **Files:** All under `docs/` tracked in git; diffs reviewed before merge

---

## 3. Launch Landing Pages (Public)

### 3.1 Pages to Build
- **Pricing page:** `/pricing` — tier comparison table, FAQ, CTA "Start Free"
- **Features page:** `/features` — token economics, billing, beta status callout
- **Docs:** `/docs/getting-started` — how to sign up, add payment method, check usage
- **Status page:** `/status` — uptime dashboard (Stripe connectivity, token API latency)

**Files:**
- `app/pricing/page.tsx` — Next.js page, tier table, `<BetaBanner />`
- `app/features/page.tsx` — feature list
- `app/docs/getting-started/page.tsx` — help content
- `app/status/page.tsx` — status indicators (pulled from `public.service_status` table, updated by monitoring)

---

## 4. Cross-Signup & Partner Integrations (TBD: Placeholder)

### 4.1 "Illuminati" Cross-Signup
- **Definition:** [REQUIRES CLARIFICATION] Partner integration? Internal cross-org login? OAuth federation?
- **Placeholder assumption:** Allow users to sign up with existing OAuth provider (Google/GitHub) in addition to email/password
- **Files:** `lib/auth/oauth.ts` — OAuth callback handler (if implemented)
- **Status:** BLOCKED until requirements clarified

### 4.2 "TankShark" Program
- **Definition:** [REQUIRES CLARIFICATION] Referral program? Partner reseller? Internal beta users?
- **Placeholder assumption:** Invite-only beta group with higher token allocations for feedback
- **Files:** `lib/features/invite_codes.ts` — validate invite, grant bonus tokens
- **Status:** BLOCKED until requirements clarified

---

## 5. Acceptance Criteria (Complete)

### Functional
- [ ] User signs up via email → auto-creates org → receives free tier (10K tokens/month)
- [ ] Stripe test mode active (ORCH_STRIPE_MODE=test); live key NOT in test env
- [ ] User can add payment method → upgrade to Starter tier
- [ ] Monthly token allowance resets on billing cycle; overage tracked
- [ ] Free-tier signup is instant (<2s); Stripe checkout <5s load time
- [ ] Landing pages render without JS errors; pricing table accurate
- [ ] Beta banner appears on all pages; never hidden
- [ ] Existing users can link payment method without re-signup

### Legal/Compliance
- [ ] Terms of Service updated; owner signed off (email in `docs/legal-sign-offs/tos-2026-07-29.txt`)
- [ ] Privacy policy covers token logging + 90-day retention
- [ ] Billing addendum signed (Stripe terms, overage policy, dispute handling)
- [ ] No test credit card data in production logs
- [ ] Test fixtures (e.g., `test-user@apparently.local`) isolated to staging env

### Test Coverage
- [ ] 20+ unit tests: signup, org creation, tier lookup, token burn calculation
- [ ] 10+ E2E tests: signup → payment → token usage → billing cycle
- [ ] Integration test: Stripe webhook → token event → usage dashboard
- [ ] Security: no plaintext passwords in logs; no PII in error messages
- [ ] Performance: signup <2s p99, token burn flush <100ms, pricing tier query <50ms

### Monitoring & Ops
- [ ] Dashboard: daily signup count, Stripe error rate, token burn distribution
- [ ] Alerts: Stripe API errors >0.5%, token buffer flush fails >0.1%, overage calculations drift >1%
- [ ] Rollback plan: if Stripe integration fails, disable payments → free tier only (manual operator fix)
- [ ] Invoice retention: test invoices deleted every 24h via cleanup job (scheduled task)

### Uptime/Availability
- [ ] Signup SLA: 99.5% availability (Stripe outages excluded)
- [ ] Billing SLA: invoices generated within 1h of cycle end
- [ ] Token API SLA: 99.9% (metering never blocks caller)
